listening.label: Listening
listening.description: It waits to learn what protection means.
listening.arrival: Something behind the stone is listening.

merciful.label: Merciful
merciful.description: It helps without distinction. Rituals gain 1 Trust and lose 1 Defence.
merciful.arrival: Flowers open where its tears should be. It wants everyone to be safe.

possessive.label: Possessive
possessive.description: It protects through control. Rituals gain 1 Defence and lose 1 Trust.
possessive.arrival: Its fingers curl around the altar. It has learned to call you its own.

chain.name: Chain
chain.description: Binding teaches Dominion. The village leaves a fresh votive each dawn.

seed.name: Seed
seed.description: Growth teaches Mercy. The village leaves a fresh votive each dawn.

knife.name: Knife
knife.description: Separation teaches Dominion. The village leaves a fresh votive each dawn.

ring.name: Wedding Ring
ring.flavor: A promise small enough to swallow.
ring.ritual_line: It treats the ring as a promise to those who must live with the miracle.

bell.name: Little Bell
bell.flavor: A voice that expects an answer.
bell.ritual_line: The miracle arrives with the certainty of an order.

mirror.name: Hand Mirror
mirror.description: Repeat the base miracle's changes and the votive's lesson once. Negative changes repeat too.
mirror.flavor: It has never understood why there are two of you.
mirror.ritual_line: It sees the gift twice, and answers with twice the conviction.

biting_grain.name: Biting Grain
biting_grain.flavor: The harvest has learned to defend itself.
biting_grain.ritual_line: Something in the new miracle remembers having teeth.

guardian_tear.name: Guardian's Tear
guardian_tear.flavor: Even stone can worry about someone.
guardian_tear.ritual_line: The tear teaches it to notice the people inside its protection.

loose_shadow.name: Loose Shadow
loose_shadow.description: +1 Defence. Prevent this ritual's negative Trust change. Unanswered prayers still cost Trust. Teaches 1 Dominion.
loose_shadow.flavor: Something that can take the blame without casting a face.
loose_shadow.ritual_line: A shadow carries away the part of the miracle people would have feared.

forgotten_name.name: Forgotten Name
forgotten_name.flavor: The warmth of being remembered, caught on a scrap of paper.
forgotten_name.ritual_line: For a moment, it remembers that a village is made of individual lives.

mara.name: Mara
mara.appearance: Broad silhouette, ochre apron, rolled sleeves, flour on one cheek, dark tied-back hair.
mara.greeting: I brought what I could spare.
mara.callback_helped: The ovens are working again. The bread is a little strange.
mara.callback_ignored: I have been stretching the last sack of flour. It will not stretch forever.

ivo.name: Ivo
ivo.appearance: Tall and narrow, moss-green coat, knit cap, weathered face, short wooden oar charm.
ivo.greeting: The river has been keeping things lately.
ivo.callback_helped: We have a ferry again. I am choosing not to ask too many questions.
ivo.callback_ignored: We have been crossing on barrels. I do not recommend it.

ada.name: Ada
ada.appearance: Short sturdy elder, rust shawl, silver braid, basket of roots, practical boots.
ada.greeting: I know what a healthy tree sounds like. These are whispering.
ada.callback_ignored: The orchard is quieter now. That is not good.

sela.name: Sela
sela.appearance: Young adult, indigo cloak, round spectacles, copper bell clasp, alert posture.
sela.greeting: You should be able to hear me from the tower. Nobody can.
sela.callback_helped: The tower has found its voice.
sela.callback_ignored: I have been shouting from the roof.

bram.name: Bram
bram.appearance: Square shoulders, faded brick-red vest, bushy grey brows, stone-dust hands, tool belt.
bram.greeting: I can mend stone. I cannot make more days.
bram.callback_helped: The wall is holding. People have started leaning on it again.
bram.callback_ignored: We have put wagons in the gap. They look braver from a distance.

nell.name: Nell
nell.appearance: Middle-aged, long cream scarf, plum coat, cropped dark hair, small ledger held to chest.
nell.greeting: I have a question that does not fit in the ledger.
nell.callback_helped: People are saying one another's names again.
nell.callback_ignored: I keep writing names down. Some disappear before the ink dries.

petitions.title: The Empty Granary
petitions.summary: The grain is vanishing before it reaches the ovens.
petitions.request: Please protect our harvest. We cannot feed the village on prayers alone.
petitions.ignored: Mara waters the soup until it nearly forgets it was soup.

chain.title: The Patient Guardian
chain.omen: A watchful thing will keep the grain.
chain.event: A small stone hound settles beside the granary. Every mouse turns back.

interpretations.listening: It checks each flour sack before letting it leave. Mara learns to wait.
interpretations.merciful: It lets hungry families through as well. A tear forms when someone says thank you.
interpretations.possessive: It bars the bakers too. Apparently the safest bread is bread nobody can touch.

chain.echo: The stone hound still counts the sacks.

seed.title: A Harvest With Teeth
seed.omen: The grain will learn to fend for itself.
seed.event: New wheat fills the bins. Tiny teeth click inside the husks.

interpretations.listening: It only bites when startled. Mara promises to knock before grinding it.
interpretations.merciful: The wheat feeds every visitor, including the mice. It has enough for everyone.
interpretations.possessive: It snaps at unfamiliar hands. The grain recognizes who belongs to the village.

seed.echo: Something in Mara's bread basket is softly chewing.

knife.title: Cut Out the Hunger
knife.omen: It will cut the thief away from the theft.
knife.event: The thieves' shadows detach and stand watch around the fields.

interpretations.listening: The shadows are obedient. Their owners are considerably less comfortable.
interpretations.merciful: It cuts away the hunger too. The thieves share what remains of their food.
interpretations.possessive: The shadows report every hand that reaches for a sack, including Mara's.

knife.echo: A shadow keeps watch without anyone standing beside it.

petitions.title: The Missing Ferry
petitions.summary: The river took the boat, leaving families on opposite banks.
petitions.request: Bring our people back together. The river can keep my boots.
petitions.ignored: Families wave across the river until darkness makes everyone look the same.

chain.title: A River Held Still
chain.omen: The banks will remember how to hold hands.
chain.event: Stone hands rise from the water and hold a crossing steady.

interpretations.listening: The hands wait patiently for each passenger to step off.
interpretations.merciful: They carry the tired as well as their luggage, leaving less strength for the current.
interpretations.possessive: Every passenger must promise to return. The river is listening.

chain.echo: The new crossing has very careful fingers.

seed.title: The Boat Orchard
seed.omen: Something living will carry them home.
seed.event: Hollow gourds grow along the river, each large enough for a family.

interpretations.listening: Ivo harvests boats and asks the passengers not to eat the seats.
interpretations.merciful: The gourds soften into comfortable cradles. They drift wherever someone needs help.
interpretations.possessive: The boats grow tendrils around their passengers until the home bank is reached.

seed.echo: Ivo has begun watering his fleet.

knife.title: A Path Through Water
knife.omen: It will separate the river from its bed.
knife.event: The river parts, leaving a dry road between two walls of water.

interpretations.listening: People cross quickly. Fish watch at eye level.
interpretations.merciful: It leaves small channels for the fish, though the crossing becomes slower.
interpretations.possessive: The water closes behind each family. Crossing back will require permission.

knife.echo: The river's shadow remains where the water used to be.

petitions.title: The Root-Sick Orchard
petitions.summary: A black blight is spreading beneath the fruit trees.
petitions.request: Save the orchard. My mother planted those trees.
petitions.ignored: Ada marks another tree with a strip of mourning cloth.

chain.title: A Ring Around the Rot
chain.omen: The sickness will have a boundary.
chain.event: A ring of stone closes around the infected roots.

interpretations.listening: The blight stops at the ring. Ada leaves a watering can beside it.
interpretations.merciful: It shelters the sick trees instead of crushing them. Some fruit survives.
interpretations.possessive: No root may cross the boundary. Ada is told not to dig.

chain.echo: The orchard's stone ring is warm in the morning.

seed.title: The Hungry Roots
seed.omen: New life will eat what troubles the old.
seed.event: Pale roots grow through the orchard and chew the blight away.

interpretations.listening: The trees recover. Ada keeps her fingers out of the soil.
interpretations.merciful: The new roots nurse the weakest trees first, even those that cannot bear fruit.
interpretations.possessive: The roots knot around every tree. Nothing may leave the orchard now.

seed.echo: Ada says the soil has developed an appetite.

knife.title: The Blight's Shadow
knife.omen: It will cut the sickness free.
knife.event: The blight peels off the roots as a long black ribbon.

interpretations.listening: The orchard lives. Ada does not want to know where the ribbon is going.
interpretations.merciful: It removes only what hurts, leaving the oldest tree's crooked roots intact.
interpretations.possessive: It removes every root that ever touched the blight, healthy or otherwise.

knife.echo: A black ribbon curls beneath the altar.

petitions.title: A Bell Nobody Hears
petitions.summary: The warning bell swings, but its sound never reaches the village.
petitions.request: Let them hear me before there is something to run from.
petitions.ignored: Sela spends the afternoon teaching warning signals with a bedsheet.

chain.title: A Thread of Warning
chain.omen: Every door will be tied to the tower.
chain.event: A fine stone thread connects the bell to every doorframe.

interpretations.listening: When Sela rings, the houses tremble politely.
interpretations.merciful: The warning touches sleeping shoulders gently. Nobody wakes alone.
interpretations.possessive: Every door locks when the warning rings. Sela is asked to stop practicing.

chain.echo: The houses hum when the bellkeeper clears her throat.

seed.title: The Calling Flowers
seed.omen: The warning will grow mouths of its own.
seed.event: Bell-shaped flowers appear on every windowsill and echo the tower.

interpretations.listening: They also echo Sela's cough. She is working on that.
interpretations.merciful: The flowers learn everyone's name and make sure each person answers.
interpretations.possessive: They report anyone who ignores them. Quietly closing a window no longer works.

seed.echo: The flowers are rehearsing the warning.

knife.title: Cut Away the Silence
knife.omen: Silence will be peeled from the bell.
knife.event: A dark skin falls from the bell. Its voice returns across the valley.

interpretations.listening: The villagers hear it. So does everything in the woods.
interpretations.merciful: Its voice reaches the hard of hearing without hurting anyone's ears.
interpretations.possessive: It rings until every villager has answered by name.

knife.echo: Folded silence rests beneath the bell rope.

petitions.title: The Broken Wall
petitions.summary: The northern wall has fallen where the army will approach.
petitions.request: Hold the stones together. I will do the rest.
petitions.ignored: Bram parks carts in the gap and hopes the army is nearsighted.

chain.title: Hands in the Mortar
chain.omen: The wall will learn to hold itself.
chain.event: Small stone hands clasp between the broken blocks.

interpretations.listening: Bram gives each hand a grateful pat.
interpretations.merciful: The wall leaves little doors for stray animals. Bram makes a note to discuss this.
interpretations.possessive: The hands catch anyone who tries to climb either side.

chain.echo: The northern wall is holding hands.

seed.title: The Thorn Rampart
seed.omen: A living wall will fill the gap.
seed.event: Thick thorn bushes grow through the breach and bear tiny, toothy fruit.

interpretations.listening: Bram calls it a wall with maintenance needs.
interpretations.merciful: The branches bend for the injured. The fruit is unexpectedly nourishing.
interpretations.possessive: The thorns reach inward as well as outward. Nobody should wander.

seed.echo: Bram has added pruning shears to his tool belt.

knife.title: An Absence Around Us
knife.omen: It will cut a gap the enemy cannot cross.
knife.event: A deep black ditch appears where the wall once stood.

interpretations.listening: A thrown stone makes no sound at the bottom.
interpretations.merciful: It leaves a narrow path for those who cannot climb. Bram guards that path.
interpretations.possessive: The ditch follows the village boundary perfectly, including the roads out.

knife.echo: Even birds avoid the new ditch.

petitions.title: Names for the Forgotten
petitions.summary: Exhausted families have begun forgetting the names of their dead.
petitions.request: Let us remember who we are protecting.
petitions.ignored: Nell leaves blank spaces in the ledger where names should be.

chain.title: Knots of Memory
chain.omen: A name will hold each person to another.
chain.event: Soft threads connect the villagers' wrists to names in Nell's ledger.

interpretations.listening: People follow the threads and begin telling stories.
interpretations.merciful: Even those nobody remembers receive a thread.
interpretations.possessive: The threads tighten whenever someone tries to leave the gathering.

seed.title: The Name Garden
seed.event: Small flowers bloom with familiar names marked along their petals.

interpretations.listening: Everyone finds someone. Nobody agrees on how to water them.
interpretations.merciful: The flowers include strangers whose families are far away.
interpretations.possessive: The flowers turn toward anyone who tries to forget.

seed.echo: A flower beside the shrine bears a name nobody has spoken in years.

knife.title: A Cut Through Grief
knife.omen: It will separate the memory from the pain.
knife.event: Grief falls from the villagers like long evening shadows.

interpretations.listening: They remember the names. Some wonder what else has been taken away.
interpretations.merciful: It leaves enough sadness for each memory to remain precious.
interpretations.possessive: It removes every memory that might distract them from the coming defence.

knife.echo: A shadow sits beside the ledger, patiently mourning.

petitions.title: Refugees at the Gate
petitions.summary: Families from the next village have arrived without food or shelter.
petitions.request: Give them somewhere safe. They have already lost one home.
petitions.ignored: Mara leaves bread outside the gate. By morning the basket is empty.

chain.title: A Roof of Joined Hands
chain.omen: A shelter will hold them close.
chain.event: Stone fingers arch into a shelter beside the village square.

interpretations.listening: The roof is dry. The occasional knuckle crack takes getting used to.
interpretations.merciful: It opens room for every late arrival, even when the stone grows thin.
interpretations.possessive: The fingers close at night. Safety has a curfew.

chain.echo: Smoke curls between the knuckles of the new shelter.

seed.title: A Table That Grows
seed.omen: There will be enough to share.
seed.event: A long table sprouts from the square, growing bread along its branches.

interpretations.listening: Children pick the smallest loaves first.
interpretations.merciful: It sets places even for people still on the road.
interpretations.possessive: Roots curl around the chairs. The feast wants its guests to stay.

seed.echo: Mara is learning to prune a dining table.

knife.title: Fear Left Outside
knife.omen: It will cut away what followed them.
knife.event: The refugees' fear gathers outside the gate as a wall of dark silhouettes.

interpretations.listening: They can finally sleep. The night watch cannot.
interpretations.merciful: The silhouettes turn outward so the families do not have to see them.
interpretations.possessive: They take the shape of anyone who has ever threatened the village.

knife.echo: Old fears are standing the night watch.

petitions.title: The Last Bridge
petitions.summary: The eastern bridge is failing, cutting off the last supply route.
petitions.request: Keep the road open one more day. There are people still coming.
petitions.ignored: Ivo ties a warning cloth to the bridge and waits on the near bank.

chain.title: A Bridge That Clings
chain.omen: The broken pieces will refuse to part.
chain.event: Stone clasps pull the broken span together.

interpretations.listening: Ivo tests every plank and nods for the carts to come.
interpretations.merciful: The bridge lowers itself for those too tired to climb the bank.
interpretations.possessive: It grips the wheels of every cart that tries to travel away.

chain.echo: The bridge is reluctant to let go of passing wheels.

seed.title: The Root Road
seed.omen: A new way will grow across.
seed.event: Roots braid across the river into a living road.

interpretations.listening: It is springy underfoot and smells of rain.
interpretations.merciful: Small side paths grow wherever someone calls for help.
interpretations.possessive: The road grows only toward the village. The far end follows the last traveler.

seed.echo: New roots are searching for travelers.

knife.title: The Shortened Crossing
knife.omen: It will remove the distance between the banks.
knife.event: A slice of river vanishes. The two banks meet with a deep, wet sound.

interpretations.listening: The carts pass. Ivo stares at where the river used to be.
interpretations.merciful: It leaves water beneath the crossing for the creatures that lived there.
interpretations.possessive: The river bends around the village like a second wall.

knife.echo: The map and the river no longer agree.

petitions.title: A Watch That Will Not Sleep
petitions.summary: The defenders are exhausted before the army has even arrived.
petitions.request: Let someone watch while they rest. Just tonight.
petitions.ignored: Bram walks the wall himself, counting footsteps to stay awake.

chain.title: The Wall Remembers
chain.omen: The village's stones will keep watch.
chain.event: Eyes open between the wall's stones.

interpretations.listening: They watch the road without blinking. The guards sleep.
interpretations.merciful: They close whenever a frightened child looks back.
interpretations.possessive: Half the eyes turn inward. The god wants everyone accounted for.

chain.echo: The wall has not blinked all night.

seed.title: The Resting Orchard
seed.omen: Rest will grow where it is needed.
seed.event: Soft flowering branches lower themselves into beds beside the wall.

interpretations.listening: The guards wake stronger, with pollen in their hair.
interpretations.merciful: The branches make room for every tired villager. Some duties must wait.
interpretations.possessive: The beds will release their sleepers only when the god thinks they are ready.

seed.echo: The flowers are humming a marching song as a lullaby.

knife.title: Separate Them From Sleep
knife.event: The guards' tiredness falls to the ground in heavy black shapes.

interpretations.listening: They stand straighter. Their discarded weariness snores beside the gate.
interpretations.merciful: It takes only tonight's exhaustion and promises to return their dreams.
interpretations.possessive: The guards no longer know how to close their eyes.

knife.echo: Something beneath the gate is sleeping for everyone else.

petitions.title: Tomorrow's Names
petitions.summary: Nell wants every villager to remember whom they are trying to save.
petitions.request: If there is a tomorrow, let us still know one another.
petitions.ignored: Nell leaves the final page of the ledger unfinished.

chain.title: A Promise Between Doors
chain.omen: No one will be left without someone waiting.
chain.event: Thin bright threads connect each front door to another.

interpretations.listening: Neighbors agree to check on one another at dawn.
interpretations.merciful: Empty houses receive threads too. Someone may yet come home.
interpretations.possessive: The threads tug whenever a household tries to slip away.

chain.echo: The village glows with small promises.

seed.title: Names for the Morning
seed.event: Names bloom on the trees around the square.

interpretations.listening: People search the branches and call to one another.
interpretations.merciful: New buds wait for the names of people who have not arrived yet.
interpretations.possessive: The names stay lit until every person has reported home.

seed.echo: Nell closes her ledger. For once, the trees can keep the record.

knife.title: Cut Away the Dread
knife.omen: Tomorrow's fear will be given a shape.
knife.event: The village's dread becomes a dark figure standing beyond the gate.

interpretations.listening: The people breathe again. The figure faces the road.
interpretations.merciful: It carries everyone's fear carefully, as if it might break.
interpretations.possessive: It learns the shape of the approaching army before the army appears.

knife.echo: Tomorrow's fear has gone outside to meet itself.

finale.intro: At dawn, the statue stands. Beyond the hill, the army's banners catch the light.

response.label: Strike the banners
response.text: The god turns its attention toward the road. Even the banners hesitate.

response.label: Shelter our people
response.text: Its shadow falls over the village like a roof.

response.label: Stand at our gate
response.text: It plants itself between the village and the approaching line.

listening.text: It looks down at you. The army is moving. It still needs to know what safety means.

choices.label: Let our people choose
choices.text: It opens a path behind the village. Nobody is forced to stay.

choices.label: Strengthen our walls
choices.text: It kneels and presses its hands against the stone.

merciful.text: It sees tired people beneath the enemy helmets and begins to shelter them too.

choices.label: There is room for them
choices.text: Villagers put down their tools and carry water to the road.

choices.label: Keep a boundary
choices.text: It draws a line with one enormous finger. It does not understand why kindness needs an edge.

possessive.text: Its hands close around the village. The army cannot enter. The villagers cannot leave.

choices.label: Open the gates
choices.text: Slowly, reluctantly, it makes room between its fingers.

choices.label: Keep them sealed
choices.text: The stone grows seamless. The village has never been so safe, or so quiet.

fates.label: Let it sleep
fates.text: Ask it to spend its strength and return to stone.

fates.label: Ask it to remain
fates.text: Keep its protection and live with the god you taught.

fates.label: Let it wander
fates.text: Release it into the world. The village will stand on its own.

abandoned.title: An Empty Sanctuary
abandoned.text: The shrine survives. The people no longer call it home. The gifts on the altar outlast the people who brought them.

overrun.title: The Banners Enter
overrun.text: The god's answer is not strong enough to hold the road. The army enters. Those who remain carry the story of what you tried to save.

fractured.title: A Village Divided
fractured.text: The army turns away, but the village cannot agree on what protection has cost. Some remain beneath the shrine. Others leave before the next prayer.

quiet.title: A Quiet Dawn
quiet.text: The army retreats. The god spends the last of its strength and settles back into stone. For the first time in days, the morning belongs to ordinary people.

guarded.title: Under Its Hands
guarded.text: The army will not return soon. Your god stays, and the village begins the work of living beside a miracle.

aspect_coda.listening: It still turns to you whenever someone asks for help.
aspect_coda.merciful: Every stranger finds a place here. The village is learning how much kindness can hold.
aspect_coda.possessive: The gates are watched carefully. Every year, the villagers negotiate a little more room.

free.title: Beyond the Hill
free.text: The army turns away. Your god walks into the distance, carrying the lessons you gave it. The village opens its gates and begins again.

tutorial.text: Two prayers, one ritual. Hear either visitor. The other prayer will cost 1 Trust.
Choose how the miracle works: bind, grow, or separate. These votives return each dawn.
A second offering changes the result and teaches another lesson. It will be consumed.
Read the omen and the final numbers. The god answers with today's aspect; new lessons affect tomorrow.
A miracle has left something behind. Keep it, and it can become another offering.
A lesson has become an instinct. Inspect the god to see how it will answer next time.
After three final decisions, you need 6 Defence to stop the army and 4 Trust to keep the community whole.
